blurb: This check looks for Shared Storage Pool capacity on a VIOS and is separate from ssp_cluster. No cluster is not applicable. ioscli cluster -status reports cluster and pool state, not pool size or free space (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/power7/8231-E1D?topic=commands-cluster-command). Those numbers belong to lssp, which this check does not run. A configured cluster is not assessed, and no capacity number is graded.
